notes.title: Hotfix [v2.3]
notes.notes:
We are continuously monitoring the performance of official servers and have released a hotfix to address recent issues. Thank you for your support!

[Fixed] Fixed cosmetics being invisible in some scenarios
[Fixed] Issue that caused performance loss on Official Servers

[Rebalance] Both shotguns, but especially Double Barrel have a higher chance to one-shot kill on close range
[Rebalance] Increased damage at medium range for Winchester
[Rebalance] Increased Winchester accuracy in ADS
[Rebalance] Increased arms damage multiplier - better chance at one-shot kill with Boys AT
[Rebalance] Decreased legs damage multiplier

We are still working on fixing occasional server crashes and planning to improve position synchronization to prevent player teleportation.

notes.title: 🔥 MAJOR UPDATE – DEDICATED SERVERS & MORE! 🔥
notes.notes:
Soldiers! The biggest Frontline Inferno update is here!  

We’re bringing you dedicated servers, new weapons, graphical settings, gameplay improvements, and much more.  


🖥 DEDICATED SERVERS 🖥  
This has been one of the most requested features, and we’ve put a huge amount of work into making it happen. Dedicated servers are finally here, bringing a much more stable and smooth online experience.  

No more host migration issues! Say goodbye to matches being ruined because the host left – with dedicated servers, games will continue running no matter what.  

Please note that dedicated servers are currently in a testing phase. We’ll be monitoring performance and making adjustments based on your feedback – so let us know if you encounter any issues!  


 💥 NEW WEAPONS! 💥   
https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/CD2yHPxdtPqmcu_S-MxdNqIPhrlWH7bcDhkqh-x1gdw/https/i.ibb.co/nNZfgqbY/new-Weapons.png?format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1341&height=676
🦾 Boys AT Rifle – A hard-hitting anti-tank rifle with devastating one-shot potential, but slow and heavy to wield.  
💥 Double Barrel Shotgun – The ultimate close-range beast – two barrels, two kills!  


⚙️GRAPHICAL SETTINGS ⚙️   
Another highly requested feature is finally here! Now you can tweak graphics settings to match your needs:  
✔️ Resolution options – Adjust your display settings to boost performance.  
✔️ Potato mode – Enable low-graphics mode for an even smoother experience on weaker PCs.  


🎩 OFFICERS ON THE BATTLEFIELD 🎩
https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/_x5HeJ9r2NBRP4sAFrMpcxnm5oYkC1PNqUQ-vDsecHc/https/i.ibb.co/qFDLWY7v/oficers.png?format=webp&quality=lossless  
Want to support the dedicated servers of Frontline Inferno?  Now you can! 
Purchase a stylish officer’s uniform and a few smaller skins to stand out on the battlefield.  
Every purchase helps maintain the servers, and you’ll get to enjoy a unique look while playing! 


🏆 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS 🏆  
https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/p0nveEmG7rZ4BsJhWb85JgTgDF9ntMQ1LAepLdWk15A/https/i.ibb.co/7xxs3NJh/achievmenty.png?format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1341&height=676  
We’ve added a few new achievements to give you even more to unlock and strive for! Can you complete them all?



⚙️ QUALITY-OF-LIFE IMPROVEMENTS  
🔹 Auto-reload – When you run out of ammo, your weapon will automatically reload.
🔹 Audio Fixes – We've addressed issues with spatial sound after player death.
🔹 New Limb Damage – Now arms and legs have their own damage multiplayer.

🔄 OTHER CHANGES  
⚖️ Weapon Balance Updates – Tweaked stats to improve gameplay fairness.  
🔧 Map Fixes – Patched various minor map issues.  
🐛 Minor Bug Fixes – General stability and performance improvements.  

📅 UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW!  
Thank you for your continued support – Frontline Inferno keeps evolving because of you! 

SEE YOU ON THE BATTLEFIELD!

notes.title: Your Journey Begins – Player Progression Update [v2.0]
notes.notes:
The wait is over – version 2.0 is here, and it’s packed with exciting new features to elevate your gameplay experience! Let’s dive into what’s new:


🎯 Player Progression System

Our goul for this update was to provide a way for players to progress, unlocking new weapons and cosmetics. There are currently 100 levels to unlock by gaining XP in matches.

Earn XP by playing matches, getting kills, and securing 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place finishes!
Unlock a variety of rewards as you level up, including cosmetics to customize your style and new weapons to rule the battlefield!
Gain 5x more XP when playing in public lobbies!

https://i.ibb.co/Ypc009r/progression.png
You can still unlock old cosmetics by completing achievements. It's also worth to mention, that the whole progression system and everything it unlock is COMPLETELY FREE. It is NOT a battle pass.

It’s time to show your skills and climb the progression ladder!

🔫 New Weapons
We’re adding two iconic weapons to your arsenal:

STG44: A versatile and powerful assault rifle, perfect for medium to long-range engagements. Its balanced performance makes it a very universal choice.
Winchester shotgun: A close-range beast with devastating stopping power. Ideal for clearing rooms and turning the tide in tight situations.

https://i.ibb.co/WHB079S/weapons.png

🛠️ Bug Fixes and Improvements

Fixed a rare issue where kills were not being credited properly, making players stuck with 0 score.
Added join and leave server messages to keep track of who’s in your game.
Implemented several minor map fixes. There are still a few problematic spots we are looking into.
You can now change weapons using the scroll wheel – a smoother way to switch in the heat of battle!
Added volume sliders for both music and hit effects, giving you more control over your audio experience.
Ammo box now restores ammunition in both weapons.
Added new soldier uniforms, you can select them with arrows below your soldier in Customization panel (if unlocked).
Changed hit sounds.
Fixed rare issue preventing weapon reload.
Added new achievements related to new weapons.



Thank You for Your Support!

This update marks a major milestone for the game, and we couldn’t have done it without your feedback and dedication. Dive in, start earning XP, and enjoy everything [v2.0] has to offer!

Let us know what you think of the changes and share your progression milestones in the community forums!

notes.title: Day 3 Hotfix [v1.3] + Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been working on more fixes and tweaks for Frontline Inferno based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new in this update:


[Fixed] Sensitivity problems while aiming down sights.
[Fixed] Issue where the cosmetics panel wouldn’t properly work sometimes.
[Fixed] "Ghost players".
[Fixed] Max players in team.
[Fixed] (again) PPSH-41 achievement.

[Changed] Medkits now heal a full 100 HP.
[Changed] Medkits now have blue cross on it (to avoid any war crime accusations 😅)
[Changed] Full lobbies now automatically move to the bottom of the list.
[Changed] Adjusted max ammo for the PPSh-41 from [71/213] to [71/142]. 


Besides that, we’re currently investigating an issue where kills are not granting points for some players.
We’re also exploring the idea of adding spawn protection to prevent instant deaths at spawn points.

In terms of new features we can give you a little sneak peek on what we are currently working on:

https://i.ibb.co/rdvV3Hc/sneakpeak.png

Thanks for all your support and feedback, it keeps us going!
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix [v1.1]
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work addressing bugs and improving gameplay based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new in version 1.1:

[Fixed] Issues with achievements not tracking progress correctly.
[Fixed] Problems with joining games after having previously joined another session.
[Fixed] Spawn issues where players were appearing outside the map.
[Fixed] Floating medkits appearing in unintended locations.
[Fixed] Kills not resetting properly between rounds.

[Changed] Updated the damage sound effect for a more impactful feel.
[Changed] Increased the fire rate of the M1 Garand for smoother gameplay.
